test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive voice form of the given sentence.

The children are doing hard work.

options.text: Hard work was being done by the children.
Hard work had been done by the children.
Hard work is being done by the children.
Hard work is done by the children.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Hard work is being done by the children."**
